content.title: About
content.content: Animal-shaped cookie with frosting is a sweet treat molded into various animal figures and coated with a smooth sugar or buttercream frosting. The dough is typically made from wheat flour, butter, sugar, and eggs, and after baking the pieces are decorated with bright frosting, often tinted with food coloring.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The animal shapes make the cookies especially popular with children and at themed parties.
Frosting can be either sugar-based or butter-based, allowing a range of flavors and textures.
These cookies are traditionally prepared for the holiday season in many European and North American cultures.
Special metal or plastic cutters are used to achieve detailed animal silhouettes.
They are often sold in assortments where each piece represents a different animal.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Provides carbohydrates that quickly replenish energy stores.

items.title: B‑vitamin content
items.content: Whole‑grain versions of the dough supply modest amounts of B1, B2, and niacin.

items.title: Calcium from frosting
items.content: If the frosting contains milk powder, it can contribute a small amount of calcium.

items.title: Gluten and dairy allergy
items.content: Traditional recipes contain wheat flour and dairy, which may trigger reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: The frosting adds significant sugar, so consumption should be moderate, especially for children.

items.title: Choking hazard for young children
items.content: Small or hard animal figures can pose a choking risk for toddlers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the cookies as a standalone snack, use them to decorate cakes, cupcakes, or ice cream, or serve them as themed treats at children’s parties.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life, store in the refrigerator to prevent the frosting from softening. Avoid exposure to direct sunlight.
